Ask the organization: The one-year commitment appears only on the on-site form; is it still required under the POINT process?
Ask the organization: No dog-walking days or times are published.
Ask the organization: Is the weekly dog-walking minimum (2 hrs, from the on-site form) still current under the POINT process?
Ask the organization: Is this a regular recurring commitment under the current (POINT) process?
Contact or more information: https://theanimalhavenct.org/contact/
Read and apply on Friends of the New Haven Animal Shelter's own website: https://findafriendforlife.org/volunteer.html (status: Confirm with organization).
Complete required step: Individual orientation at the shelter (about 1 hour) after the application is accepted: shelter tour, handling demonstration if relevant, and a discussion of interests.
Orientation: After an application is accepted, an individual orientation of about 1 hour is scheduled at the shelter. No orientation dates are published.
Be ready to show or confirm: Able to work independently and read the shelter's cage cards
Ask the organization: Bathing is hands-on dog work. Does the Mon-Sat 12:30-4:30 rule apply, and are handler training or mentor sign-off required?
Ask the organization: Where does bathing take place?
Ask the organization: No application link is currently posted.
Contact or more information: https://findafriendforlife.org/index.html
